verse.verse_2: And when the stars fall down.
verse.verse_3: And when the oceans are swept away.
verse.verse_4: And when the graves are overturned.
verse.verse_5: Every soul will come to know what it has sent ahead and what it left behind.
verse.verse_6: O man! What has deceived you away from your Lord, the Most Beneficent?
verse.verse_7: The One Who created you, then moulded you, then made you proper?
verse.verse_8: He moulded you into whatever shape He willed.
verse.verse_9: Not at all – but rather you deny the establishment of Justice.
verse.verse_10: And indeed there are some guardians over you.
verse.verse_12: Knowing all what you may do.
verse.verse_13: Indeed the virtuous are in serenity.
verse.verse_14: And indeed the sinners are in hell.
verse.verse_15: They will enter it on the Day of Justice.
verse.verse_16: And will not be able to hide from it.
verse.verse_17: And what do you know – of what sort is the Day of Justice!
verse.verse_18: Again, what do you know – of what sort is the Day of Justice!
verse.verse_19: The day on which no soul will have the authority over any other soul; and on that day, the entire command belongs to Allah.
